scope: Optimization15 only; auxiliary diagnostics. No holdout diagnosis, candidate selection or new formal timing.
definitions: Requested heap excludes allocator size-class rounding, foreign malloc, executable mappings and internal transient realloc backing.
Per-call additional live requested heap excludes pre-call compilation/catalog/input storage. Absolute baseline includes the diagnostic harness.
Process maximum RSS includes startup, catalog, compiler, inputs and all diagnostic activity; it is not checked-call peak memory.
Managed admission counters include reservations/retained claims; they are not physical RSS or CPU instructions.
No diagnostic elapsed time enters the frozen benchmark or training selection.
Generated module sizes and static instructions include retained cold fallbacks and exclude Rust helper machine code. They are not retired instruction counts.
Reported native stack is compiler metadata, not measured process RSS or a complete dynamic call-stack high-water mark.
Whole executable file size includes compiler/runtime, metadata and debug/linker sections; it is not per-program generated code size.
Source work/comparison counters are logical resource obligations, not physical CPU instructions. Actual heap peaks and allocation traffic remain to be instrumented after the formal run.

interpretation.capacity: Measured peak additional live requested Rust heap ranges7072..242656 bytes across the15 programs. This is scoped requested Rust heap, not total process RSS, allocator rounding or complete native stack high-water.
interpretation.allocation_churn: Deriche1094 and correlation608 allocation/reallocation requests per checked call are the largest counts. Eight measured calls per program have identical telemetry summaries and return managed admission to baseline after output release.
interpretation.generated_work: Warm samples attribute87.45% of Gram–Schmidt and53.69% of Durbin self time to generated functions, so reducing host allocations alone will not resolve their native computation cost.
interpretation.matrix_preparation: MVT and correlation still spend substantial self time allocating/freeing and planning/validating. Their whole program code size is not a substitute for hot-path attribution.
interpretation.semantic_note: Source inspection found MatrixSqrt absent from the direct numeric-operation layout. The resident Snapshot sqrt uses libm and deliberately has no platform-sqrt witness; do not substitute FSQRT without the genuine semantic registration/proof. This remains a separate source gap, not the selected next experiment.
